Singapore (Asia/Singapore) uses UTC+8.  
US/Eastern uses UTC-5 (standard time).  

Difference in offsets: (-5) - (+8) = -13 hours.  

Source time: 19:00 (7 PM) on October 17, 1073.  
Target time = 19:00 + (-13) = 06:00 on October 17, 1073.  

No day boundary crossing backward?  
19:00 - 13 hours = 06:00 same day.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 06:00
